title: Reconcile the meaning-led branch with the released verifier
summary: Carry the four evidence-backed shortlists into a future candidate from the released kit and retain its asset, handoff, and license checks.

origin.source: Public Brand Identity Template source and release review

benefits: Keeps deeper concept work compatible with the current adopter workflow.

The released verifier includes readiness and handoff checks.
